mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER ( id, password, user_name, nick_name, email, phone_number, profile_image_url, is_email_auth, is_in_active, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{password}, #{userName}, #{nickName}, #{email}, #{phoneNumber}, #{profileImageUrl}, #{isEmailAuth}, #{isInActive}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT idx, id, password, user_name as userName, nick_name as nickName, email, phone_number as phoneNumber, profile_image_url as profileImageUrl, is_email_auth as isEmailAuth, is_in_active as isInActive, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE idx = #{idx}

SELECT idx, id, password, user_name as userName, nick_name as nickName, email, phone_number as phoneNumber, profile_image_url as profileImageUrl, is_email_auth as isEmailAuth, is_in_active as isInActive, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT idx, id, password, user_name as userName, nick_name as nickName, email, phone_number as phoneNumber, profile_image_url as profileImageUrl, is_email_auth as isEmailAuth, is_in_active as isInActive, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET nick_name = #{nickName}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, profile_image_url = #{profileImageUrl}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE idx = #{idx}
UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET is_email_auth = #{isEmailAuth}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET is_in_active = #{isInActive}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE idx = #{idx}
